name: Malav Rana
headline: Frontend Engineer
summary: Frontend Engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance, and accessible web applications. Skilled in React, Angular, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks. Experienced in integrating REST and GraphQL APIs, optimizing complex UI workflows, implementing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and accessibility compliance. Collaborative team player focused on delivering user-friendly, maintainable software solutions across multiple projects.

skillDescriptions.Frontend: Hands-on experience across React.js, Next.js, Angular, and Vue.js with TypeScript, modern CSS (Tailwind, Styled Components, CSS Modules), and responsive design. Comfortable from Figma handoff through production builds with Webpack, Vite, and Babel.
skillDescriptions.Backend / API: Integrates REST and GraphQL services with secure patterns—JWT, OAuth, CORS—and works alongside Node.js, Java, and Spring Boot backends for data-driven UIs.
skillDescriptions.Testing: Ships with confidence using Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, and Playwright across unit, integration, and end-to-end coverage with automation in the release path.
skillDescriptions.Database: Works with relational and document data stores—MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis—and SQL for schema-aware features and performant queries.
skillDescriptions.DevOps / Tools: Uses Git, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker, and AWS in CI/CD pipelines with monitoring, ESLint, and Prettier for consistent, observable delivery.
skillDescriptions.Concepts: Applies WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, performance and security best practices, Agile/SCRUM collaboration, and solid engineering fundamentals (debugging, OOP, design patterns).

experience.tagline: Healthcare technology team building digital products for clinical and operational workflows.
experience.description: Develops web features with Angular (v19 and legacy), emphasizing reusable accessible UI, REST and GraphQL integrations, and Docker-based CI/CD for consistent builds and releases.
highlights: Builds reusable, accessible UI components with optimized rendering across devices and browsers.
Runs accessibility audits, closes WCAG 2.1 AA gaps, and improves usability for all users.
Integrates REST and GraphQL APIs with solid state management and error handling across modules.
Maintains Dockerized dev, test, and deployment pipelines for smooth CI/CD workflows.

experience.tagline: Kiswe powers live interactive experiences for sports, media, and enterprise brands.
experience.description: Delivered high-traffic single-page apps with React, Vue, TypeScript, and Tailwind—focusing on scalable components, API integration, performance, and accessibility.
highlights: Developed SPAs with React, Vue, TypeScript, and Tailwind using scalable component architecture.
Integrated REST and GraphQL APIs with caching and state management; improved responsiveness and reduced frontend errors.
Applied code splitting, lazy loading, and tree-shaking for faster loads on large apps.
Championed code reviews, debugging, and WCAG-aligned, cross-device experiences.

experience.tagline: Global architecture and design firm delivering enterprise digital tools and client experiences.
experience.description: Built enterprise UIs with React, Angular, Vue, and Next.js—pairing async REST/GraphQL data with automated tests and close design collaboration.
highlights: Shipped dashboards and UI components with React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, and Styled Components.
Integrated REST and GraphQL with asynchronous updates and interactive features.
Refactored legacy code, improved performance, and expanded Jest, RTL, and Playwright coverage.
Translated Figma designs into responsive, accessible, production-ready interfaces.

experience.tagline: Pharmacy benefits and digital healthcare solutions for members and patients.
experience.description: Built interactive pharmacy checkout flows in React and TypeScript with secure API integration, modular components, and strong automated test coverage.
highlights: Improved checkout task completion with React, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Integrated secure REST APIs with JWT/OAuth, validation, and robust error handling.
Reduced page load times through modular components and optimized client-side rendering.
Collaborated across teams for responsive, accessible UI delivery.

experience.tagline: Nonprofit community outreach and charitable initiatives.
experience.description: Delivered responsive, WCAG-minded web apps with reusable components, REST integrations, and Agile delivery.
highlights: Built WCAG-oriented experiences with React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Created reusable components and modular UI patterns for maintainability.
Integrated RESTful APIs for dynamic content and consistent client workflows.
Participated in Agile/SCRUM, code reviews, and documentation.
